newsitem.title: UK: Edinburgh Fund director to join Templeton.
newsitem.headline: Edinburgh Fund director to join Templeton.

text.p: Edinburgh Fund Managers said Wednesday that joint managing director Peter Arthur will leave the company to join Templeton Investment Management.
His resignation will take effect from December 1997, at which time he will become Templeton's chief legal counsel, Europe.

"We are very sorry to be losing Peter, but understand his reasons for moving. Peter has been with Edinburgh Fund Managers for 14 years and having successfully completed the integration of Dunedin and the placing of BIT's stake of Edinburgh Fund Managers, Peter decided he wanted to develop his career in a different direction." said Iain Watt, chief executive at the company. -- James Saft, London newsroom +171 542 2734
